tool.name: Flowise
tool.description: Low-code orchestration and agent workflow builder under an immediate feature freeze, with repository archival scheduled for August 10, 2026 and project end of life for August 31, 2026.

licenseHistory.notes: Both licenses are permissive and OSI-approved — a minor technical tightening (NOTICE preservation, explicit patent grant), not a source-available shift.

tool.logoNotes: Official Flowise docs-site icon asset (`Flowise Logo Dark High Res`) served from the owner-controlled documentation site. GitBook currently delivers the resized file as JPEG.
tool.practitionerNote: Active feature development has ceased. The repository is scheduled for archival on August 10, 2026 and official project support ends August 31, while the Apache-2.0 source remains available for internal or community forks.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted deployment leaves data location under customer control; no current hosted-service residency commitment is asserted.

deployment.detail: The Apache-2.0 source remains available for self-hosted forks; the official repository is scheduled for archival on August 10, 2026 and project EOL on August 31, 2026.

auditLogging.detail: No dedicated audit-log documentation; enterprise tier may add capabilities.

soc2.detail: No SOC 2 certification announced by Flowise directly.

iso27001.detail: No ISO 27001 certification found in Flowise documentation.

euAiAct.detail: Low-code agent/workflow builder tooling, not an AI model/provider.

licenseRisk.detail: Apache-2.0 core + proprietary Commercial License for packages/server/src/enterprise (SSO/RBAC/audit).
